statement: An UNRECOGNISED provenance value -- not merely an absent one -- MUST rank identically to `reconstructed`, the weakest tier. The tier set is closed, so anything outside it is unknown data, and unknown data is never promoted. Matching is exact and case-sensitive: `AUTHORED` is not `authored`.
note: Verified by execution against provenance_rank() at v0.8.3. Every listed value returns the reconstructed rank.
